Kerala CM Satheesan Faces Allegations and Case Drop

Kerala Chief Minister Satheesan has refuted allegations of assaulting an elderly woman, calling them "false". Concurrently, the Kerala Vigilance Bureau has dropped a 2018 case against him, stating he had "no role" in it. The case involved allegations of corruption during his tenure as a minister.
